messages:
ashley: kicking off canary for v3-halo (int4) on 1% traffic slice. primary checks: longdoc MRR, rerank precision@5, latency p95. auto-fallback if any metric regresses >3% over baseline for 10m window. tagging rollout as 'canary-halo-1pct'.

sanjay: quick q — which baseline are we comparing to? v3-base fp16 or v3-lite int8?

ashley: baseline = v3-base fp16 (prod stable). int8 experiments already covered; we want to see int4 delta vs fp16 for this workload.

mike: watch out for seqlen>8k tails — kv-warmup behavior changed in int4 build last time. recommend adding a longdoc slice (>=4k tokens) to holdout watchlist.

ashley: good call. adding slice: longdoc_kv_warmup. also increasing sample rate on rerank-heavy cohorts to 5% for the first 30m.

tara: can we wire eval-bot to post periodic smoke summaries to this thread? would help on-call.

ashley: yes — enabling eval-bot. smoke checks: sample size 200 per cohort, include fidelity checks and hallucination rate.

mike: propose lowering the auto-fallback threshold to 2.5% for rerank precision@5 specifically, since small rank shifts are user-visible. keep 3% for MRR and latency.

ashley: ok: policy updated: rerank precision@5 fallback 2.5% over 10m; MRR/latency 3% over 10m.

ashley: rollout config snippet:
```
canary_fraction: 0.01
watch_slices: ["longdoc_kv_warmup","rerank_heavy","short_q"]
metrics: {"mrr":"3%","rerank_p5":"2.5%","latency_p95":"3%"}
autofallback_window: 600
notify_channels: ["#eng-ml","#eng-oncall"]
```

eval-bot: smoke-run: started 60s ago. running cohorts: rerank_heavy (n=200), longdoc_kv_warmup (n=120), short_q (n=200). will post results every 3m.

sanjay: reminder: include concordance check vs fp16 for hallucination heuristics (exact-match fallback for critical fields).

ashley: added concordance check — if hallucination rate delta >1% absolute and concordance <95% then immediate rollback trigger.

mike: one more: add a temporary route pin for VIP customer foo-inc to keep on fp16 until canary stable. low overhead and reduces blast radius.

ashley: done — route pin for foo-inc on fp16.

eval-bot: smoke-run update (t+3m): rerank_p5 delta = -1.9% vs fp16 (within threshold), mrr delta = -2.1% (ok), latency_p95 delta = +1.8% (ok). longdoc_kv_warmup anomalies: 3/120 sessions showed kv-merges leading to longer gen times — investigating.

mike: that longdoc behavior sounds like the kv-gc heuristics we tweaked. lower the kv-merge threshold for canary VMs and re-run smoke on that slice.

ashley: reducing kv-merge aggressiveness for canary and re-triggering smoke on longdoc slice.

eval-bot: smoke-run update (t+7m): rerank_p5 delta = -2.6% -> exceeds 2.5% threshold. autofallback condition met for rerank_p5. initiating circuit-breaker and rolling traffic back to fp16 for canary fraction. alerting #eng-oncall and notify-sre.

ashley: acknowledged. pulling logs and sample diffs now. please freeze further promos until we finish postmortem.

sanjay: can you dump the sample diffs to the thread? small set of examples will help model team triage.

ashley: posted diffs to internal blob (link) and pasted 3 representative snippets here. also kicking an ad-hoc eval run with expanded rerank metric set.

mike: thanks. action items: 1) revert kv-merge change in int4 build 2) re-eval quant calibration on rerank head 3) expand rerank smoke n->500 for repeatability.

ashley: noted. will open follow-up PRs and schedule a 30m triage sync.

tara: please also add a guard to block auto-promote if a rerun shows instability >1.5% over two consecutive smoke runs.

ashley: added guard. summary: canary run triggered autofallback due to rerank_p5 delta -2.6% -> rollback applied. follow-ups assigned. thanks team :handshake:
